properties.project_name: Helen Diller Family Cancer Research Building
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: the size in the notes ('161,757 sq ft plus 20,000 sq ft of vivarium space') was not found in any readable source and was replaced by SFGate's 'nearly 164,000-square-foot' with the conflict noted; the 2006 groundbreaking and June 2009 opening are now also cited to A History of UCSF and SFGate (added to source_doc_urls) because the UCSF press release returned 403. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 (675 Mission Bay Blvd in the repo's DataSF parcels copy) alone is about 12.2 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.'; notes: 'About 164,000 sq ft (SFGate, May 2009; the architect's page gives a conflicting 174,020 with a mislabelled unit), five stories, two interlocking L-shaped wings (wet labs and PI/fellow offices). Architect Rafael Viñoly Architects. Broke ground 2006 (A History of UCSF); grand opening June 2009 (UCSF's press release, not readable in the 2026-09 audit; SFGate, May 31, 2009: 'officially opens Tuesday').'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data and tax roll -- e.g. block/lot 8711507 (675 Mission Bay Blvd in DataSF's parcel data) alone is about 12.2 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: About 164,000 sq ft (SFGate, May 2009; the architect's page gives a conflicting 174,020 with a mislabelled unit), five stories, two interlocking L-shaped wings (wet labs and PI/fellow offices). Architect Rafael Viñoly Architects. Broke ground 2006 (A History of UCSF); grand opening June 2009 (UCSF's press release, which could not be checked in September 2026; SFGate, May 31, 2009: 'officially opens Tuesday').
